part_a_paper_retrieval_explanation.description: Explains why a paper was retrieved/reranked, including BM25 rank, dense rank, RRF score, and BGE reranker score.

part_b_claim_citation_explanation.description: Explains claim verification status (SUPPORTED/UNSUPPORTED), Stage A/B method, and cited chunk_id. However, explicit end-to-end linking from final claim to BGE rank/RRF score is fragmented across separate UI stores.

conceptual_trace_chain.chain_spec: FINAL CLAIM -> CITATION -> EVIDENCE BLOCK -> PAPER -> BGE RANK -> RRF -> BM25/DENSE ORIGIN
conceptual_trace_chain.gap: The frontend XAI modal (XAIModal.tsx) displays paper-level retrieval scores (BM25, dense, RRF, BGE), while ClaimProofDrawer.tsx displays claim-to-evidence verification. The unified end-to-end chain connecting a specific final claim back to its paper's BGE rank and BM25/dense origin is split between two separate components.

xai_history_reexecution_audit.question: Does opening old XAI history rerun search, BM25, dense retrieval, BGE, or Gemini?
xai_history_reexecution_audit.explanation: Opening old XAI history loads stored trace JSON artifacts (status_dump.json, trace_dump.json, or SQLite SearchExperiment.results). It renders cached execution traces without re-triggering search, BM25, dense vector search, BGE reranking, or Gemini inference.

api_endpoint_audit.detail: Line 305 of ai.py defines @router.get('/explain') returning {'message': 'AI Explain endpoint'}, which is a stub rather than a dynamic API.
